english.title: Large producer fail to make reports re packaging waste - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[large producer,]_
(B)_[large producer who was a brand owner, packer/filler, importer or service provider,]_
(C)_[large producer who was a distributor,]_
(D)_[large producer who was an online marketplace operator,]_

failed to report the information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), required to be reported to NRW, in accordance with regulation 17 of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023, within the timescales required by that regulation in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(2), (3) and 28(2)(b) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwas a large producer of packaging wastefailed to make the first report of the matters required by regulation 17to Natural Resources Waleswithin the timescales required by that regulation

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Please note, there is an error in regulation 28(2)(b) the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 which creates this offence. Regulation 28(2)(b) refers to regulation 18(2) and (3) however, this appears to be an error and should in fact state regulation 17(2) and (3) and containing the relevant data reporting obligations, as per the offence wording and details above.
